name: Can pool demolition permits be pulled online in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: Can pool demolition permits be pulled online in Los Angeles, and are plan attachments uploaded digitally?
mainEntity.text: Can pool demolition permits be pulled online in Los Angeles, and are plan attachments uploaded digitally?

acceptedAnswer.text: Los Angeles now routes many demolition-related permits through an online system, which makes digital submittals common. Applicants typically enter the project location, contact information, permit description, and any required attachments. If the project needs plan review, the plans or supporting documents are usually uploaded rather than delivered only on paper. That does not mean the process is automatic, however; the city may still request corrections, additional documents, or inspections before issuing the permit. Homeowners and contractors should be prepared to use the portal correctly and to respond quickly if the city asks for revisions. Online filing can speed things up, but only if the submittal is complete and accurate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, Los Angeles uses an online permit system for demolition-related applications. Applicants may need to upload permit details, location information, contacts, and any required attachments or plans through the portal.
